name: Monster picker text
notes: Shown once the logo has landed: the best time of the entry on screen above it, under the logo (BEST TIME --:-- until it wins a run; the classic and the waves entry of a monster each keep their own), arrows on both sides of the monster (yellow on the classic entries, red on the waves entries: the only sign of the mode, no label), its name and type centered under it, then a blinking PRESS START and, at the bottom, the SELECT: CLEAR SAVE hint. On a locked entry the two bottom lines become a blinking LOCKED and how to unlock it (they follow 'sel_locked', which the picker sets): WIN WITH A NEW MONSTER on a locked classic monster (only the first win of a monster that never won a run unlocks the next one), WIN WITH ALL 9 MONSTERS on the waves entries until every monster has won a classic run.

elements.text: {sel_locked|SELECT: CLEAR SAVE|WIN WITH A NEW MONSTER|WIN WITH ALL 9 MONSTERS}
